title: Integrated Management of Pathogens and Microbes in Cannabis sativa L. (Cannabis) under Greenhouse Conditions
scope: Cannabis greenhouse disease diagnosis and integrated management, including powdery mildew, Botrytis, root disease, HLVd, sanitation, irrigation, airflow, and post-harvest microbial risk.

title: Transmission, Spread, Longevity and Management of Hop Latent Viroid, a Widespread and Destructive Pathogen Affecting Cannabis Plants in North America
scope: HLVd detection, transmission pathways, persistence, sanitation experiments, propagation risk, and clean-stock management.

title: Hop Latent Viroid: A Hidden Threat to the Cannabis Industry
scope: HLVd biology, cannabis disease context, symptoms, testing, crop-quality effects, and management considerations.

title: Postharvest Drying and Curing Affect Cannabinoid Contents and Microbial Levels in Industrial Hemp
scope: Experimental drying and curing comparisons, moisture redistribution, cannabinoid measurements, color, and microbial levels.

title: Total yeast and mold levels in high THC-containing cannabis inflorescences are influenced by genotype, environment, and pre- and post-harvest handling practices
scope: Cannabis inflorescence microbial loads, microclimate, airflow, handling, drying method, moisture, water activity, and post-harvest risk factors.

title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review
scope: Drying, curing, storage, water activity, equilibrium moisture, packaging, and post-harvest process design.

title: Planning for Biological Control in Greenhouses
scope: Preventive biological control, natural-enemy selection, compatibility, environmental fit, sticky-card monitoring, scouting, and recordkeeping.

title: Integrated Pest Management in Commercial Greenhouses: An Overview of Principles and Practices
scope: Greenhouse IPM principles, plant quarantine, scouting, monitoring, sanitation, media, and integrated pest-management practices.

title: Integrated Pest Management for Greenhouse Fruits and Vegetables
publisher: Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Agribusiness
scope: Comprehensive greenhouse IPM framework and pest-management concepts for protected production systems.

title: Greenhouse Vegetable Sector Biosecurity Guide
scope: Controlled access, crop scouting, movement controls, sanitation, pest introduction pathways, and greenhouse biosecurity practices.

title: Using Integrated Pest Management in Greenhouses and Herbaceous Nurseries
scope: Regular scouting, biological-control planning, greenhouse insect screening, pest exclusion, and airflow tradeoffs.
